title: Seagrove Beach "10 Palms 30A" 70 Montigo Avenue
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach- 4-minute walk to the beach- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (May 1-August 31)- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $65 per day- Massive jumbotron facing the pool for sports and entertainment- Multiple outdoor fireplaces- 10 adult bikes- Peloton- Low Speed Vehicle- In-home elevator- Pavilion- Carriage house- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note: Current photos are digital renderings. Actual finishes, landscaping, and features may vary.DETAILS: Indulge in an unforgettable beach getaway at 10 Palms 30A. Accommodating up to 30 guests, this luxe Seagrove Beach home boasts 10 inviting bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 4 half baths—perfect for family reunions, bachelorette parties, or even a company retreat! Nestled near the picturesque 30A neighborhoods of Seaside and WaterColor, with Café Thirty-A and the Perfect Pig less than a mile away, there’s plenty to experience. Enjoy quintessential beach town charm, leisurely afternoons in the private pool, and spontaneous strolls to the turquoise Gulf—only 4 minutes away!Natural materials, coupled with sophisticated design features, evoke the feel of a coastal villa throughout this spacious, airy home. In the light-filled great room, sumptuous furnishings cultivate a comfortable setting for relaxing. The luxe kitchen is a gourmet playground for both professional and amateur chefs to showcase their culinary prowess. Savor a succulent brunch at the expansive breakfast bar, or settle around the elegant dining table for formal meals together. In the enclosed backyard, a private oasis beckons for blithe days of lounging poolside or refreshing dips in the clear, cool waters—the massive jumbotron is perfectly positioned for enjoying sports or movies while unwinding in the pool. A firepit and dual-fire features add ambiance for starlit socializing after sunset. When the night winds down, the lavish primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom promises a tranquil retreat.On the second level, accessible by stairs or an in-home elevator, 4 guest bedrooms offer peaceful havens, each with a king bed and private bathroom.Continue to the third floor to discover a primary bedroom and a guest bedroom, each with a king bed and private bathroom. Kids, teens, or bridesmaid parties will love spending jovial nights in the bunk room featuring 1 queen-over-queen bunk, 1 full-over-full bunk, 2 twin-over-twin bunks, and a private bathroom.The secluded Carriage House enjoys a kitchen, balcony, and 2 guest bedrooms with king beds.Revel in a Seagrove vacation brimming with upscale amenities and unrivaled luxury at 10 Palms 30A. On-site parking makes it easy to explore, alongside 10 complimentary adult bikes and a low-speed vehicle. Pelayo Beach Access is only a 4-minute walk—take Montigo Avenue to East County Highway 30A, turn left, and the access will be on the right past the crosswalk. Book today for a memorable beach escape!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 30):FIRST FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only!THIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Full-over-Full Bunk Bed and 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Please note that bedding configuration is subject to change!*The garage is not for guest use.
